description.content: Stop payment before running. Wallet API is unavailable during outage; test-outages.py verifies balance after restarting payment.

exec: pm.test("ordered persisted logs",()=>{ pm.expect(logs.length).to.be.above(0); logs.forEach((l,i)=>{pm.expect(l.orderId).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("kb6OrderId"))); pm.expect(l.time).to.be.a("string"); if(i) pm.expect(l.id).to.be.above(logs[i-1].id); }); });
